chapter: Ellington colleagues, singers and world tours
title: Django Reinhardt
summary: Brown remembers Django's three-fingered playing and his guest spots in France and the United States.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Ah, Django, that was the first time

we ran into a real terrific guitar player. Django didn't have but three fingers. Yeah, he had three fingers and he would impossible things with those three fingers on guitar. But he was from -- he was a gypsy, really. So he didn't stay over here very long, just made a tour or two but he stayed mostly in France, Paris, but he was very terrific, too.
You heard him in France, too?

-- he did a guest spot and then when he came over here he did a guest spot. We brought him over here. I mean, Ellington brought him over here and oh, yes, he really registered with the American audience.
